# Lock Ten Studio

> AI tools for custom residential builders, built and run by a working custom builder in Cabin John, Maryland. Two products: Walkthrough (a jobsite site-report app) and The Install (a done-for-you AI-workspace setup for a builder's business). Plainspoken, no hype, made by someone who runs a build business.

## Products

- [Walkthrough](https://lockten.ai/walkthrough): an iOS app for builders. Walk a job site, talk and take photos, and it generates a clean PDF report you text or email to your subcontractor from your own phone. No portal and no logins for your subs, they just get a text. Photos save to your own Google Drive or Dropbox, not your camera roll. It handles walkthroughs, trade lists, owner updates, decision requests, meeting notes and a persistent punch list. Three free reports to start with every feature unlocked, no credit card, then two plans: Standard at $9.99 per user per month or $99.99 per year (every report type except meeting notes and the punch list, unlimited), and Pro at $24.99 per user per month or $239.99 per year (adds meeting notes and the persistent punch list). On the App Store as "Walkthrough: Site Reports".
- [The Install](https://lockten.ai/install): a done-for-you Claude Cowork workspace setup for a builder's business (your team, projects, voice and connectors, configured for you). Tiers: Lite $297, Plus $2,997, Concierge by inquiry.

## Key pages

- [The Install](https://lockten.ai/install): the AI-workspace setup service and tiers.
- [Cowork primer](https://lockten.ai/primer): a plain-language guide to Claude Cowork for small business owners.
- [Help](https://lockten.ai/help): Walkthrough help and FAQs.

## About

Lock Ten Studio LLC, Cabin John, Maryland. The name refers to Lock 10 of the C&O Canal, a piece of 19th-century masonry engineering still standing. Contact: info@lockten.ai.
